summary_bullets.claim: High cost is a dominant complaint — consider offering a free version or lowering price.
Limited functionality is a complaint — address issues with search and downloading Bibles.

evidence.quote: It advertises many versions of the Bible and you only get 1.
I have tried this program on two different tablets. It will not download Bibles.

summary_bullets.claim: Lack of commentary is a complaint — consider adding this feature.
